scope: Go live/evidence/relay WIP and its published diagnostic claims; existing server/management dependencies read for lifecycle context.

closed_findings.standard: m2-05 and implementation record: the native runtime receives a local capability, never the provider credential.
closed_findings.problem: Valid upstream SSE echoed a synthetic provider credential through literal or JSON-escaped content and ordinary content/reasoning/tool-argument delta fragments. All five original HTTP cases actually returned 200 before repair.
closed_findings.resolution: Buffered SSE is checked before forwarding, including decoded strings, assembled deltas and the exact Go cost trailer. Echoes now reject with a fixed error and sanitized failing receipt.
closed_findings.after: standards-final.junit.xml: original five failing cases and three controls passed, 8 total.

published_input.change: Formatting and import-block whitespace only; ast.dump equality was asserted before replay.

independent_verification.ruff: Published independent test file passes Ruff after formatting.

evidence_assessment: Both final live reports bind all five current sources and independently re-evaluate as passed. Edit has three requests, read/edit and four successful cases; denied_read has two requests, explicit rule denial, no changes or upstream canary. Both report scans of 28 files with no leaks.

The earlier six HTTP 200 trailer rejects remain failed with no tool execution. Prototypes are labelled as older evidence without final source binding. The shape/trailer observations retain types and usage, not response text; null cost is explained as uncollected.

The post-DONE exception is one exact choices=[]/bounded decimal-string cost frame; extra content, tools and duplicate trailers still reject. Cost unit remains unknown. Relay failures request native abort; type parameters remain outside the bounded expression checker.

The Windows/Linux workflow explicitly runs the published Spec and Standards paths with frozen dev dependencies and without live flags. Author JUnit records for 97 Windows, 82 WSL and 37 workflow-command cases were inspected; no remote CI result is claimed.
limitations: This reviewer used synthetic credentials and local MockTransport only; the two live reports were inspected, not independently executed. No real key was read, no live provider called, no product edited and no Git mutation performed.

No general encoded-secret detection, full process-tree/network isolation, provider stop, quota/cash qualification, Profile activation or dispatch is claimed. Published Windows/WSL author regressions are not this reviewer's execution.
standards_basis: code-review skill smell baseline; no actionable material smell beyond the corrected boundary finding.
